title: Empty State
description: What a list, table or page shows when it has nothing in it yet, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Button and Skeleton primitives: an icon, a title, one line of description and up to two actions (primary and secondary), with its own loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the actions move side by side at @sm, the icon and title step up at @md and the block takes more room above and below at @lg.
